title: Gideon's Three Hundred Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Gideon’s Three Hundred Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Gideon Bible crossword: the fleece, the winnowing of the army, the trumpets and pitchers and lamps. KJV clues from Judges 6–7, free on iOS.
prose: Gideon is threshing wheat by the winepress to hide it from the Midianites when he is greeted as a mighty man of valour. Gideon's Three Hundred covers what follows — the fleece laid out twice, wet then dry; an army of thirty-two thousand cut to ten thousand and then to three hundred by the way the men drank at the water.
The victory itself is the strangest part of the grid: trumpets, empty pitchers, and lamps hidden inside them. The closing verse is the LORD's instruction that three hundred will be enough.

clues.text: Laid on the floor, wet with dew while the earth was dry
How the three hundred were chosen — by how they did this

verseText: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
